titel: Mood Reading Our Hearts Away & An Ask Us Anything!

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Mood readers discuss favorite recent reads and answer listener questions.
kurzfassung: Tina and Hannah dive into recent mood reads, share their thoughts on Riley Sager's latest thriller, and answer listener questions about their reading routines and habits. They also spin the Tackling the TBR wheel to select next month's community reading challenge. Finally, they wrap up the episode with a fresh round of individual book recommendations spanning various genres.
stichpunkte: Spinning the Tackling the TBR wheel results in a challenge to read subscription box books.
Tina shares a recent visit to the Obama Center in Chicago.
Hannah highlights the Prime Video coming-of-age drama Sterling Point.
The hosts discuss their reading experiences with The Unknown by Riley Sager.
Listeners' questions cover recording logistics, reading schedules during the day, and making reader friends.
Tina reviews the fast-paced thriller Wonderland by Jennifer Hillier.
Hannah discusses the post-apocalyptic novel The Dog Stars by Peter Heller.
Tina shares her terrifying experience reading The Mind of a Murderer by Michael Wood.
Hannah highlights the romance novel Let's Kiss and Tell by Joss Richard.
